summary: INLIF Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 18, 2026, attaching a press release announcing its strategic entry into the humanoid robotics market. The company, which designs and sells injection molding machine-dedicated manipulator arms, plans to leverage its expertise in mechanical design and motion control to develop humanoid robots. No specific financial terms, transaction, or board action are disclosed; the filing is a routine business update without merger, acquisition, or special situation mechanics. It reports ongoing R&D and strategic initiatives. This is a standard current report of a foreign private issuer outlining business strategy, not a special situation event.
